qualifying_findings.title: InternLM MindSearch Planner Agent code injection
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE-2026-105135 reports code injection in InternLM MindSearch 0.1.0. The affected component is the Planner Agent, specifically ExecutionAction.run in mindsearch/agent/graph.py, where manipulation of the inputs argument can lead to remotely initiated code injection. The CVE record says exploit details are publicly disclosed and the vendor did not respond.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: primary vulnerability record with NVD corroboration and third-party advisory references
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: InternLM MindSearch 0.1.0; Planner Agent; ExecutionAction.run; mindsearch/agent/graph.py; inputs argument.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: MindSearch is an AI search/agent system, and the vulnerability turns planner-agent input handling into a code execution boundary. It belongs locally as an agent runtime and tool-execution security issue rather than as general framework catalog coverage.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: Broad InternLM or MindSearch product context belongs upstream if a durable entity page is needed.
upstream_routing.ai_dev_wiki: General agent-framework selection or search-agent development practice belongs upstream only if later synthesis needs it.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Owns the Planner Agent code-injection boundary, affected version, exploit-public status, and mitigation follow-up.

qualifying_findings.confidence_notes: High confidence on in-window timing and relevance from CVE/NVD records. Patch or fixed-version evidence was not found in the fetched CVE data.
follow_up_actions: Create or update an agent-and-tool-security or infrastructure-and-supply-chain leaf for MindSearch Planner Agent code injection.
During ingest, check for an upstream InternLM/MindSearch advisory, patched release, or repository commit before writing durable remediation language.
Avoid reproducing exploit steps; keep synthesis focused on control boundary, affected version, and remediation status.

qualifying_findings.title: Mindio Magic MCP sensitive data exposure
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE-2026-104402 reports insertion of sensitive information into sent data in the WordPress Mindio Magic MCP plugin. The affected package is mindio-magic-mcp through 0.5.6, with the CVE record marking 0.7.1 as unaffected.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: primary CVE record with NVD and Patchstack advisory reference
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: Mindio Magic MCP / mindio-magic-mcp through 0.5.6; fixed or unaffected status indicated at 0.7.1.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: The record concerns an MCP WordPress plugin and a sensitive-data transmission boundary. MCP bridges can expose prompts, tool output, credentials, or connected application data, so sensitive-data handling belongs in the local AI security lens.

qualifying_findings.title: LaraDashboard settings API exposes AI provider keys
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE-2026-105129 reports incorrect authorization in LaraDashboard before 1.4.8. Authenticated users with only settings.view permission can read plaintext stored secrets through GET /api/settings or /api/settings/{option_name}, including AI provider API keys, mail credentials, passwords, and tokens. The CVE references a GitHub advisory, patch PR, commit, and v1.4.8 release.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: primary CVE record with vendor advisory, patch, release, and NVD corroboration
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8; settings API; settings.view permission; AI provider API keys and other stored secrets.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: The exposed data class includes AI provider API keys, making this a credential and least-privilege issue for AI-enabled dashboards and model-provider integrations.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: Broad LaraDashboard product context belongs upstream only if an entity page is needed.
upstream_routing.ai_dev_wiki: General dashboard development or settings-API practice belongs upstream only if later synthesis needs it.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Owns AI-provider key exposure, settings authorization, and least-privilege implications.

qualifying_findings.confidence_notes: High confidence: the CVE has exact in-window timestamps and points to vendor advisory, patch, commit, and release evidence.
follow_up_actions: Create or update an identity-and-access or data-and-privacy leaf for LaraDashboard AI-provider key exposure.
During ingest, verify whether v1.4.8 fully redacts settings values or changes authorization policy behavior.

qualifying_findings.title: aiir Policy Gate signature verification flaw
qualifying_findings.concise_factual_summary: CVE-2026-105161 reports improper verification of a cryptographic signature in invariant-systems-ai aiir through 1.7.0, affecting the Policy Gate Handler. The CVE record says the attack can be executed remotely, recommends upgrading, and notes the GitHub repository is no longer available and the affected product is unsupported.
qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: primary CVE record with NVD and GitHub Advisory Database reference
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: invariant-systems-ai aiir 1.0 through 1.7.0; Policy Gate Handler; signature verification and data-authenticity boundary.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: A policy-gate signature verification failure is directly relevant to AI governance and runtime control integrity, because policy gates are supposed to enforce trusted decisions before model or agent actions proceed.

upstream_routing.ai_wiki: Broad product/entity background for aiir belongs upstream only if the project is still relevant despite repository removal.
upstream_routing.ai_dev_wiki: General policy-gate development practice belongs upstream only if a durable development-pattern page is needed.
upstream_routing.ai_security_wiki: Owns signature-verification, unsupported-product, and policy-gate integrity implications.

qualifying_findings.confidence_notes: Medium-high confidence on timing and security relevance. The GitHub repository and project advisory are reported as broken links, so durable ingest should preserve the unsupported/broken-link caveat.
follow_up_actions: Create or update a governance-and-compliance or infrastructure-and-supply-chain leaf for aiir policy-gate signature verification.
